BiblicalUsage: Jezavel is Jeziel, an Israelite, a son of Azmaveth who joined David at Ziklag. In 1 Chronicles 12:3, Jeziel, and Pelet.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Jeziel belongs in the story because God put the name there, and I trust the placing.
